metadata.title: Autodesk Inventor Sketch Operations — Complete Enumeration (2D Sketcher)
metadata.description: Parameter catalog for the Inventor 2D parametric sketcher. Inventor sketches solve as constraint networks — every primitive carries dimensional + geometric constraints that drive parametric updates. Catalog covers 9 primitive families (Line, Rectangle, Circle, Arc, Ellipse, Polygon, Spline, Slot, Point), 8 editing tools, 3 reference-projection ops, 13 geometric constraints, 7 dimension constraint types, and the Construction-Geometry toggle.
metadata.source: Autodesk Inventor 2025 Help — Sketch Reference; Autodesk Inventor API Reference — PartSketch object model

commonTabs.description: Standard parameter tabs across Inventor sketch operations

LINE.description: Line creation between two sketch points. Inventor's Line tool also supports a chain mode that drops continuous coincident-constrained segments and an arc-tangent toggle for transitioning between line and tangent arc without leaving the tool.

parameters.name: Sketch Plane
parameters.description: XY/XZ/YZ origin plane, planar face, or work plane

parameters.name: Length
parameters.description: Override length — drives a dimension constraint at creation

parameters.name: Angle
parameters.description: Angle from horizontal — drives an angular dimension constraint

parameters.name: Continuous Chain
parameters.description: Auto-coincident the next line at this endpoint

parameters.name: Construction
parameters.description: Mark as construction geometry (excluded from feature consumption)

RECTANGLE.description: Closed rectangle in 4 modes: Two Point (corner-corner axis-aligned), Three Point (rotated), Two Point Centered (origin + corner), Three Point Centered (origin + edge midpoint + corner). Auto-generates Horizontal/Vertical/Perpendicular constraints.
RECTANGLE.fusion_command: n/a (Inventor uses SketchLines.AddAsTwoPointRectangle / AddAsThreePointRectangle / AddAsTwoPointCenteredRectangle / AddAsThreePointCenteredRectangle)

parameters.name: Corner 1
parameters.description: First corner (or center for centered modes)

CIRCLE.description: Closed circle in 3 placement modes: Center-Point (center + point on circumference), Tangent (3 tangent references), and Ellipse Conversion (degenerate). Inventor's tangent mode constructs the unique inscribed circle for the 3 selected entities.

parameters.name: Tangent Entities
parameters.description: Three reference entities (tangent_three) or two + radius (tangent_two_radius)

ARC.description: Open arc in 4 placement modes: Three Point (start, point on arc, end), Center Point (center, start, end with sweep direction), Tangent (tangent to existing endpoint + length/angle), Fillet (between two intersecting entities, with auto-trim).
ARC.fusion_command: n/a (Inventor uses SketchArcs.AddByThreePoints / AddByCenterStartEndPoint / AddByFillet / AddByTangent)

ELLIPSE.description: Closed ellipse defined by center + endpoint of major axis + minor radius. Inventor provides a single ellipse constructor — variant placements all reduce to this triple.

parameters.name: Major Axis Point
parameters.description: Endpoint of major axis — defines orientation + major radius

parameters.name: Minor Radius
parameters.description: Distance from center to ellipse along minor axis

parameters.name: Major Radius
parameters.description: Computed from Major Axis Point unless overridden

POLYGON.description: Regular n-sided polygon in 2 modes: Inscribed (vertices on a virtual circle of given radius) and Circumscribed (edge midpoints on the virtual circle). Inventor supports 3 ≤ N ≤ 128 sides.

parameters.name: Radius Point
parameters.description: Defines size + orientation; drives polygon-circle radius dimension

SPLINE.description: B-spline curve in 2 modes: Interpolation (passes through every fit point with computed tangents) and Control Polygon (fit points are control vertices). Inventor exposes degree (2-12), end-tangent handles, and curvature combs.

parameters.name: Closed
parameters.description: Wrap last point to first (forms closed loop)

SLOT.description: Closed slot primitive in 4 modes: Center-to-Center (two arc centers + width), Overall (overall length + width), Center (one arc center + length + width), and Arc Slot (curved slot along an arc path).
SLOT.fusion_command: n/a (Inventor 2018+ uses SketchSlots family — modeled via SketchLines + SketchArcs prior to 2018)

parameters.name: Arc Center
parameters.description: Center of curved slot path (arc mode)

POINT.description: Standalone sketch point. Used as construction reference, drill-hole center for the Hole feature, or work-point creation seed. Inventor distinguishes 'Hole Center' (drives the Hole feature) from 'Sketch Point' (reference-only).

parameters.name: Hole Center
parameters.description: Mark as drill-hole center (consumed by Hole feature)

TRIM.description: Trim sketch entity to nearest intersection. Inventor auto-detects intersections with all sketch entities + projected geometry; selecting a region trims toward that region.

parameters.name: Reference Point
parameters.description: Point on the segment to remove

EXTEND.description: Extend sketch entity to nearest boundary entity. Direction inferred from cursor position; supports preview before commit.

BREAK.description: Split a sketch entity at a specified point into two coincident-constrained segments. Useful for selectively dimensioning sub-segments.

parameters.name: Break Point
parameters.description: Location on entity where the split occurs

OFFSET.description: Offset selected sketch entities by a signed distance. Inventor supports loop selection (closed-chain offset) and individual-entity offset. Auto-generates Equal-Distance constraints between source and offset.

parameters.name: Side
parameters.description: Resolves sign ambiguity for closed loops

MIRROR.description: Reflect selected entities across a sketch line. Inventor adds Symmetric geometric constraints between source and image so subsequent edits maintain symmetry.

parameters.name: Mirror Line
parameters.description: Sketch line acting as the mirror axis

parameters.name: Keep Source
parameters.description: Retain original entities (always true for sketch mirror)

MOVE.description: Translate selected entities by a vector. Inventor optionally preserves constraints to source entities or breaks them so the moved set is independent.

parameters.name: Copy
parameters.description: Keep source AND create translated duplicate

parameters.name: Optimize
parameters.description: Preserve constraints to environment when possible

ROTATE.description: Rotate selected entities about a center by an angle. Optionally copies the rotated set.

SCALE.description: Scale selected entities about a base point by a factor. Inventor allows fractional scaling (0 < factor); negative factors require Mirror instead.

PROJECT_GEOMETRY.description: Project edges, faces, or vertices of existing 3D model geometry onto the sketch plane. Projected entities update parametrically when the source moves.

parameters.name: Source
parameters.description: Edge / face / vertex / work-point to project

PROJECT_TO_SURFACE.description: Project a sketch curve onto a 3D surface, preserving the projection direction. Result is a 3D curve usable in Sweep / Loft path inputs.

INTERSECT_CURVE.description: Create a sketch curve at the intersection of a face/surface with the sketch plane. Useful for trimming sketches to imported geometry boundaries.

GEOMETRIC_CONSTRAINT.description: Add a geometric (relational) constraint between two sketch entities. Inventor exposes 13 types: Coincident, Collinear, Concentric, Equal, Fix, Horizontal, Parallel, Perpendicular, Smooth, Symmetric, Tangent, Vertical, and Pattern (for derived patterns).

parameters.name: Entity B
parameters.description: Required for binary constraints (parallel/perpendicular/tangent/concentric/coincident/equal/collinear/smooth/symmetric); not used by horizontal/vertical/fix

parameters.name: Reference Line
parameters.description: Required for Symmetric — line of symmetry

DIMENSION_CONSTRAINT.description: Add a dimensional constraint that drives sketch parameters. Inventor's General Dimension tool infers the dimension type from the selection (linear, angular, radial, diametral, arc-length, tangent-distance, two-line angle).

parameters.name: Selection
parameters.description: Two points / one entity / two entities, depending on type

parameters.name: Tolerance
parameters.description: Symmetric / Bilateral / Limits / Limits-Stacked / Reference / Basic

FILLET_SKETCH.description: Round the corner between two intersecting sketch entities with a tangent arc. Inventor auto-trims the source entities to the new arc endpoints and drops a tangent constraint at each end.

parameters.name: Equal Constraint
parameters.description: Add equal-radius constraint with first-placed fillet (chain mode)

CHAMFER_SKETCH.description: Cut a beveled corner between two sketch lines. Inventor supports 3 modes: Equal Distance, Two Distance, and Distance + Angle.

parameters.name: Distance 2 / Angle
parameters.description: mm in two_distance, deg in distance_angle

PATTERN_RECTANGULAR.description: Linear-array existing sketch entities along two independent direction vectors with count and spacing. Used heavily for hole arrays + sheet-metal punch patterns.

parameters.name: Direction 1
parameters.description: Reference line / edge for first axis

parameters.name: Direction 2
parameters.description: Reference for second axis (optional 1D pattern when omitted)

PATTERN_CIRCULAR.description: Polar-array existing sketch entities about a center with count and total/incremental angle. Counter-clockwise default.

CONSTRUCTION_TOGGLE.description: Toggle the Construction property on selected sketch entities. Construction geometry participates in the constraint solver but is excluded from feature consumption (Extrude/Sweep/Loft skip construction).

parameters.name: Construction
parameters.description: Set true to mark as construction; false to mark as profile

TEXT_SKETCH.description: Place driven text in a sketch (used as profile for embossed/extruded text features). Supports font / style / size / alignment + leader-line for callouts.
